flags.evidence: Accepted checkpoint-matched PDF p59 Figure 13(a), sourced from 4965edd sec_results.tex:867–910 and f22bc25 figure naca0012_m015_laminar_re5000_forces.png SHA256 2e3066e48d70436cb70d3bb8efcab1b63dd555dcb690a38ed50c437ccf957ea0, labels the M015 laminar force history as case convergence evidence. It ends step1500, Cd≈0.11887/Cl≈0.0012046, matching f22bc25 results/scaling/naca0012_m015_laminar_re5000_np8/forces.csv SHA256 031a20c88ff2acdedaaa7a624b61f56096c17c082985b13d351cbb35a3cc2e11; canonical selected results/naca0012_m015_laminar_re5000/forces.csv SHA256 beb6e2b681d0b30160bcfbb1b67e596cb91999b6e9b80c9627c0c6de47ac780e ends step3839, Cd0.0551808/Cl−0.00169723. Figure manifest lists same name for canonical and scaling runs, and tools/make_figures.py:115–145,208–217 generates them under shared metadata case_id. This is a proven report-figure-to-selected-data mismatch, not evidence of synthetic solver data.

limitations: No evaluator solver rerun was performed; Re200 was never rerun.
Raw artifacts were excluded from curated tip.
Immutable report rendering contains pervasive missing-asset placeholders.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
